cells.value: A tool card is one page per app: the one route to use, which login, what it reaches and can change (tested, with the date), and its rules, with the hazards and the asks first. How the cards reach every AI: (1) the always-loaded App rules block names every card and says to read it before the first call, plus the two cross-app rules (name the login; samples can send or spend, budgets ask Alex and never go through proxy) (blind split test 2026-10-01: work/2026-10-01_setup-playbook/notes/app-rules-redesign.md); (2) the hosted notes tool Composio CUSTOM_IR_NOTES_GET_APP_RULES returns a full card on any machine, and its description lists every card with its index line; (3) the card files themselves (~/.agents/tools/cards). Hard stops are also enforced by the guard hooks. Edit the card and commit ~/.agents: the hook updates the hosted notes, the instructions and this tab. Never edit the sheet by hand.
